protocol.name: kinetic-motion-refinement-v1
protocol.scope: Earlier insect/synthetic test results have been inspected and are reused exploratory development evidence. Nine new non-insect GMOT40 category clips are predeclared confirmation, scored only after validation selection is frozen.

baseline_v2.description: Frozen previous executable, identical active output/shared tracker rules.

motion_uncertainty.description: Uncertainty hard gate and soft Mahalanobis cost; direction and endpoint recovery disabled.

motion_direction.description: Direction cost with uncertainty hard gating retained; no soft Mahalanobis cost or endpoint recovery. Not a pure direction-only gate.

motion_full.description: Uncertainty/direction costs and post-gap endpoint velocity recovery; not full OC-SORT ORU.

motion_full_gate25.description: Single declared alternative gate25 with other full-profile knobs fixed.

motion_hybrid_iou.description: Validation-stage amendment: high-IoU fallback retains strict non-overlap uncertainty/ambiguity guards; original strict failures remain reported.

motion_hybrid_full.description: Validation-stage amendment: high-IoU fallback retains strict non-overlap uncertainty/ambiguity guards; original strict failures remain reported.

motion_hybrid_no_recovery.description: Validation-stage amendment: high-IoU fallback retains strict non-overlap uncertainty/ambiguity guards; original strict failures remain reported.

recovery.description: Final validation-stage candidate: preserve both IoU confidence passes, then cautiously recover only unmatched confirmed tracks from unmatched high-score detections before birth. Endpoint velocity update only for recovered pairs.

selection.tie_break: source-balanced IDF1, then prefer unchanged two_stage on an exact tie

confirmation_rules.claims: Nine additional non-insect category clips; not full benchmark or verified recording/session-independent generalization.

protocol.matched_control: Exact per-sequence realized K calls uniformly over N frames; clone all treatment association, motion, scene, risk_scope and output knobs, change only schedule and uniform_calls. Retrospective content-independent comparator, not causal online scheduling.
protocol.timing_scope: Cached association/scheduling quality only; no live FPS, new-detector training, or whole-pipeline generalization claim.

amendments.stage: After initial strict-motion validation; before any fresh confirmation scoring
amendments.reason: Strict uncertainty gating regressed on raw insect validation, motivating a bounded high-IoU fallback. All original strict ablations and failures remain reported.

amendments.stage: After strict and hybrid motion validation, before any fresh confirmation scoring
amendments.reason: Global non-overlap edges can displace strong IoU matches. One final recovery-only association preserves the original two IoU passes before considering cautious unmatched high-score recovery.

amendments.stage: Before any confirmation scoring or freeze; after user requested5–10 more videos
amendments.reason: Expand confirmation beyond bees/insects to nine additional categories. Index2 except ball3/person0/stock1 to keep selected image archive bytes under300MB; no performance-based selection.

secondary_selection.purpose: Separately select budget_profile for miss/skip recovery on fixed2 validation, before fresh confirmation.
secondary_selection.validation_groups: Same synthetic/raw-insect groups and .5/.5 weights as primary selection
secondary_selection.association_selection: Evaluate all predeclared profiles at fixed2; maximize source-balanced HOTA, tie-break source-balanced IDF1, prefer unchanged two_stage on exact tie.
secondary_selection.schedule_selection: Choose budget_schedule only among already declared schedule settings using validation under budget_profile; do not choose on confirmation.
secondary_selection.confirmation_allowed_profiles: Quality-selected profile, validation-selected recommended budget_profile, baseline_v2 and two_stage only.

reference_controls.scope: Official pinned implementations, every-frame same frozen detections, native active-output semantics; fixed before confirmation scoring. Not identical lifecycle to controlled ablations.
reference_controls.note: max_age OC19 approximates .75s at nominal25fps; Byte23 buffer scaled internally by25/30. No new training; first-frame exemplar belongs to source detections.

scope: Prior test data reused exploratory; additional confirmation clips unscored by this runner before freeze. No post-confirmation tuning.

content.selection_basis: Validation only. Quality and budget association selected separately under every/fixed2 using identical source-balanced HOTA and raw-insect non-regression guard. Budget schedule: maximize same balanced HOTA among declared <=51% realized-call options, raw HOTA within0.5points of fixed2; tie IDF1 then fewer calls. No confirmation results used.

selection.tie_break: source-balanced IDF1, then prefer unchanged two_stage on an exact tie

limitations: Detector weights are frozen. Cached detection quality is distinct from real inference throughput.
Original test clips were already inspected; additional confirmation is scored only after this recommendation is frozen.
